prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Daitoku-ji main-temple Karamon gate, the ACTUAL ornate Momoyama national-treasure gate in the photo. Preserve its distinctive central curved karahafu roof, four gate posts and carved transom; show gate alone without flanking wall, stone monument, trees or steps. Do not substitute another Daitoku-ji subtemple gate.
